# Skycally

> Skycally is a free online toolbox with 100+ browser-based tools for images, PDFs, video, audio, text, AI writing, calculators, and casual games. No signup, no uploads to external servers where possible — most tools run entirely in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Skycally and featured tools.
- [All Tools](/tools): Full catalog of every tool, grouped by category.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides and tutorials for using free online tools.
- [About](/about): What Skycally is and who builds it.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the Skycally team.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.

## AI & Writing

- [AI Image Generator](/tools/ai-image-generator): Free text-to-image generator powered by Flux. 15 styles, 5 aspect ratios, no watermark.
- [AI Image Animator](/tools/image-animator): Animate any photo with cinematic Ken Burns, zoom, pan and parallax effects. Export MP4 or GIF, no signup.
- [AI Writing Assistant](/tools/ai-writing-assistant): Grammar checker, paraphraser and text summarizer in one tool.
- [AI Email Writer](/tools/ai-email-writer): Draft professional emails from a short brief.
- [AI Cover Letter Generator](/tools/ai-cover-letter-generator): Generate tailored cover letters.
- [AI Resume Builder](/tools/ai-resume-builder): Build a clean resume from a form.
- [Word Counter](/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters and reading time.
- [Word Processor](/tools/word-processor): Rich-text editor with export to DOCX and PDF.
- [Speech to Text](/tools/speech-to-text): Transcribe audio to text.
- [Text to Speech](/tools/text-to-speech): Convert text to natural voice.

## Image

- [Image Compressor](/tools/image-compressor): Shrink JPG, PNG and WebP files.
- [Image Converter](/tools/image-converter): Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP and more.
- [Image Resizer](/tools/image-resizer): Resize by pixels, percentage or social preset.
- [Image Cropper](/tools/image-cropper): Crop images to any aspect ratio.
- [Remove Background](/tools/remove-bg): Erase image backgrounds in the browser.
- [Image Upscaler](/tools/image-upscaler): Enlarge images with AI.
- [Add Text to Image](/tools/add-text-to-image): Overlay custom text on any image.
- [Meme Generator](/tools/meme-generator): Build memes with classic templates.
- [Collage Maker](/tools/collage-maker): Combine photos into a collage.
- [Color Picker](/tools/color-picker): Pick colors from images and swatches.

## PDF

- [Compress PDF](/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size.
- [Merge PDF](/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one.
- [Split PDF](/tools/split-pdf): Split a PDF into pages or ranges.
- [Rotate PDF](/tools/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages.
- [PDF to Images](/tools/pdf-to-images): Export PDF pages as PNG or JPG.
- [Image to PDF](/tools/image-to-pdf): Turn images into a single PDF.
- [PDF to Word](/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to editable DOCX.
- [Word to PDF](/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert DOCX to PDF.
- [Protect PDF](/tools/protect-pdf): Password-protect a PDF.
- [Document Scanner](/tools/document-scanner): Scan documents from the camera.

## Video & Audio

- [Video Compressor](/tools/video-compressor): Compress video files in the browser.
- [Video Trimmer](/tools/video-trimmer): Trim video clips.
- [Video Merger](/tools/video-merger): Merge multiple clips.
- [Video to GIF](/tools/video-to-gif): Convert video segments to GIF.
- [Add Subtitles](/tools/add-subtitles): Burn subtitles into a video.
- [Extract Audio](/tools/extract-audio): Extract the audio track from a video.
- [Audio Converter](/tools/audio-converter): Convert between MP3, WAV, OGG and more.
- [Screen Recorder](/tools/screen-recorder): Record your screen in the browser.

## Utilities & Calculators

- [QR Generator](/tools/qr-generator): Create QR codes.
- [QR Reader](/tools/qr-reader): Scan QR codes from image or camera.
- [Password Generator](/tools/password-generator): Generate strong passwords.
- [Hash Generator](/tools/hash-generator): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 hashes.
- [Base64 Encoder](/tools/base64): Encode and decode Base64.
- [JSON Formatter](/tools/json-formatter): Format and validate JSON.
- [Unit Converter](/tools/unit-converter): Convert length, mass, temperature and more.
- [Currency Converter](/tools/currency-converter): Live currency rates.
- [Loan Calculator](/tools/loan-calculator): Personal loan payments.
- [Mortgage Calculator](/tools/mortgage-calculator): Home loan payments.
- [BMI Calculator](/tools/bmi-calculator): Body mass index.
- [Age Calculator](/tools/age-calculator): Exact age from a birthdate.

## SEO Tools

- [Keyword Research Tool](/tools/keyword-research): Real Google search volume, CPC, competition and related keywords, powered by Semrush.
- [Website Traffic Checker](/tools/domain-analysis): Estimate any domain's organic traffic, keyword count and top ranking pages.
- [Backlink Checker](/tools/backlink-checker): Authority score, total backlinks, referring domains and top referrers.
- [Keyword Difficulty Checker](/tools/keyword-difficulty): Bulk Google ranking difficulty for up to 10 keywords with volume and CPC.
- [Competitor Analysis Tool](/tools/competitor-analysis): Auto-discover real search competitors, keyword overlap and traffic.
- [Page SEO Analyzer](/tools/page-seo-analyzer): See every Google keyword any URL ranks for, with positions and traffic share.

## Optional

- [Games](/tools?cat=games): Casual browser games (Sudoku, Chess, 2048, Wordle and more).
